root_cause.code: src/kernel/program_loader.c proc_marshal_argv -> pl_strcpy; src/kernel/arch/{arm,x64}/trap.c sys_exec flat-args u_strcpy
root_cause.mechanism: w6-run raised the per-argv-element copy cap 64 -> HO_EXEC_ARGV_LEN (4096). pl_strcpy/u_strcpy validate the WHOLE cap range up front (pl_user_ok(src, 4096) -> vm_touch). vm_touch fails (-EFAULT) when the range crosses the END of a mapped region. A fork+exec child builds argv/exit-code on the USER STACK ~0x238 below the stack top (v2 AS: stack region [0x17F8000000, 0x1800000000), SP 0x1800000000; frames _start 0x50 + main 0x130 + exec_cycles 0x80 + exec_cycle 0x50, code[] at sp+0x20 -> code@0x17fffffdc8). A 4096-byte pre-check from there reaches ~3.5 KiB past the stack top into unmapped space -> the range check rejects -> pl_strcpy returns 0 -> proc_marshal_argv drops argv[2] -> blob is ['TORTURE.BIN','child'] (argc=2) -> child main() takes the missing-arg default code=7 -> exit(7) != want(10..17) -> waitpid status 0x700 (WIFEXITED, WEXITSTATUS 7) fails every cycle -> -1, exec_ok=0, exec_rejected=0.
root_cause.why_not_actually_intermittent: Deterministic on ARM: the only local 'PASS at tip' was the native HOST build (merged-battery6-2026-10-14.log, suite_ms=301, total_kb=65536 mock) which never runs the ARM code. Every ARM run at 288995c fails (VM merged-w7 + merged-w7r, local ARM battery rerun merged-battery6-wave-rerun suite_ms=33898, and 6/6 local selfhost-harness runs with code@=0x17fffffdc8 stable and st=0x700 code=7 on all 16 forks). Pre-w6 ARM (cap 64) passes every run. The check outcome is a fixed function of (code[] offset below stack top) vs (cap = 4096), so the w6 cap bump makes it trip 100% of the time in the ARM build. The per-page fix validates only the bytes copied, so it holds at any stack depth/load.
root_cause.discrimination: probe build at unfixed tip (workstation, selfhost harness): child argv2=10 code@=0x17fffffdc8 argv@=0x17fffffda0 (argv intact in the child); parent waitpid st=0x700 exited=1 code=7 sig=0 want=10..17 on all 16 forks. H1 (argv[2] dropped in the kernel marshal -> default exit 7) PROVEN; H2 (child fault-killed after ok) RULED OUT (exited=1, sig=0); H3 (4096-wide sys_exec stack locals overflow) RULED OUT (per-CPU kernel stacks are 64 KiB; the flat-args fallback is not even the argv source); H4 (cxxrt.o/libc.a delta) RULED OUT (the same binary drives a healthy child that prints ok and exits normally; only the marshalled argv was short). serials: docs/selfhost/lanes/evidence-w8-torture/w8-probe-fail.serial.txt (pre-fix FAIL) and w8-fix-probe.serial.txt (post-fix PASS, same addresses).

fix.change: pl_strcpy (program_loader.c) and u_strcpy (arch/arm/trap.c + arch/x64/trap.c): validate per page (exactly the bytes copied) instead of the whole cap up front; a page mid-string that is unreadable still drops the arg (same 0 return). Matches the established exec_read_str envp pattern.
fix.w6_purpose_preserved: long argv elements (sh -c '<recipe line>', the w6-run S0/S1/S2 in-OS build lines up to ~1.3 KB) are copied fully - every page spanned is validated/materialised as read.
